about_the_game:
The Demon Lord's Lover is a roguelike rpg and adult dating sim. Explore an ever-changing dungeon, battle enemies in turn-based, grid-based tactical combat, and develop relationships with various heroines.

  • Explore The Demon Lord's Dungeon, an ever-changing dungeon with monsters, other adventurers (friends and foes), traps, and treasures. Battle enemies turn-based, grid-based tactical combat. Use items, skills, and even the terrain to get an edge.

  • Explore Foothold, a town with a colorful cast of adventurers, artists, and outlaws. Upgrade items and skills at the shops and the training ground. Get to know the residents via quests and conversations.

  • Develop relationships with various heroines, including Viola the knight, Miran the mage, Paila the seamstress, Torne the shopkeep, Nanako the isekai-ed idol, Bell the fighter, and Seri the demon lord (and your childhood friend).

content_descriptors.notes: All characters engaged in sexual conduct are 18+ years of age. All sexual conduct is consensual.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04, Ubuntu 24.04
  • Processor: x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2+, Vulkan capable GPUs
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Big Sur 11 or newer
  • Processor: X64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support (Intel processors) Apple M1 or above (Apple silicon-based processors)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-capable Intel and AMD GPUs
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 version 21H1 (build 19043) or newer
  • Processor: X64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support, ARM64
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX10, DX11, DX12 or Vulkan capable GPUs
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
